node.title: B-WEAK primitive-residue endpoint budget
node.statement: At every admissible prize row, the first-owner primitive central mass satisfies q^{-t+H}W_cen^prim<=2^121. Equivalently, this is the U-weighted joint valid-skew mass after removal of quotient/coset classes owned by the structured staircase column. The implication is proved from the reduced C2'' reserve X_prim<=2^21 product_j E_U[rho_j] and the 100-bit marginal baseline product_j E_U[rho_j]<=2^100. Both are named open inputs. The unreduced endpoint is refuted by dli_unreduced_coset_endpoint_counterexample and is not part of this node.
node.attack_surface: Close or refute the reduced C2'' primitive joint reserve and the 100-bit marginal baseline; do not transport quotient-periodic mass into this primitive owner.
node.falsifier: An admissible row with q^{-t+H}W_cen^prim>2^121 under the exact first-owner split, or a refutation of the printed conditional implication.
node.notes: The status is a proved implication, not proof of the endpoint. The 2026-08-18 correction restores the _reduced qualifier already present in the original C2'' input and required by the x4 primitive ownership contract. Historical experiments and route failures remain in the referenced documents.
